Class Setting

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.settings.Setting
public final class Setting extends Object
One line of the Tempest settings menu: a number field, an on/off toggle, a text field, a colour picker, or a heading.

A number or text field can be given an item icon with icon(String). A field marked inline() is drawn on the same row as the field before it, so one row can hold an icon, a title and two fields (numbers, text or one of each): 

Setting.number("Copper ore", 0, 100, 2, getChance, setChance).icon("Ore_Copper").caption("Chance %"),
Setting.number("Coins", 0, 1_000_000, 0, getValue, setValue).inline()
A row can also show a live example of what its fields make, with preview(Supplier).

Where there are only a few right answers, give the admin a dropdown instead of a number or a code to type (API version 3): 

Setting.choice("Opening style", List.of(Setting.option("strip", "Spinning strip"), Setting.option("board", "Prize board")),
        c::getStyle, c::setStyle)
Setting.choiceNumber("Starting corner", List.of(Setting.option("1", "Top right"), Setting.option("2", "Left")),
        c::getCorner, c::setCorner)
Setting.item("Key item", c::getKeyItem, c::setKeyItem)   // every item in the game, with a search box
